description: This file defines a static object 'VideoCatalog' that provides a hardcoded list of sample video items with metadata and URLs, used for testing or demonstration purposes in a video player app.

classes.name: VideoCatalog
classes.description: An object providing a static list of video items for testing purposes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined sample VideoItem objects with titles, descriptions, URLs, and optional thumbnails.
